name: Shimshai
overview: Shimshai is identified in Scripture as a scribe who, alongside Rehum the chancellor and various companions, actively opposed the rebuilding of Jerusalem by writing letters to King Artaxerxes. These letters, recorded in Ezra 4, reveal Shimshai's role in political opposition, as he and his associates used official correspondence to halt the work on Jerusalem through royal authority and force. This account highlights the influence and responsibility of scribes like Shimshai in the governance and control of the Persian Empire during the post-exilic period.
